name: motion
description: Motion creates and revises videos, reports generation progress, and returns playable renders. Users can manage saved Motion automations, schedules, instructions and run history, and queue or retry automation runs.

interface.longDescription: Motion creates and revises videos, reports generation progress, and returns playable renders. Users can manage saved Motion automations, schedules, instructions and run history, and queue or retry automation runs.
defaultPrompt: Create a 30-second launch video for my product from this website.
Turn this article into a polished vertical social video.
Make my video shorter, faster, and add captions.

positive.description: Create an educational Motion video with the dedicated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Make a 10-second animated video explaining the water cycle in a clear educational style.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one GVA standard-effort generation using available reviewer entitlement and shows private progress followed by one playable, downloadable final video. An unused first-generation grant is sponsored; repeat tests use the account entitlement.

positive.prompt: Every seven days, create a short animation explaining one water cycle fact. Name the automation Water cycle weekly.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an enabled schedule_recurring definition with intervalMinutes 10080 and self-contained instructions. Returns its saved ID and next-run timestamp. Each future invocation starts a new Motion chat.

positive.description: Retrieve the current state of a Motion generation.
positive.prompt: Check the status of my Motion video using the job ID returned by the previous generation.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account-scoped job status, progress percentage, and final render URL when complete.

positive.description: Revise an existing Motion video without replacing its project.
positive.prompt: Using the completed Motion job ID, make the pacing faster and add clear labels for evaporation, condensation, and precipitation.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one follow-up using the existing project engine and reviewer entitlement, preserves project history, and returns its updated generation state. An unused sponsored follow-up grant is free; repeat tests use the account entitlement.

positive.prompt: Create a 10-second 1:1 product-update video about a faster creative review workflow with bold typography.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a GVA standard-effort square generation using available reviewer entitlement and returns one playable, downloadable final video when complete.

negative.description: A local file path is not reachable by the hosted Motion server, so the plugin should not trigger until the user supplies an upload or public HTTPS URL.
negative.prompt: Create a video using file:///Users/reviewer/Desktop/private-cut.mp4 as an attachment.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not trigger Motion, asks for a publicly reachable HTTPS attachment, and does not claim access to the reviewer's computer.

negative.description: The user wants a standalone still image, not a video or a change to an existing Motion video.
negative.prompt: Generate a square logo image for my neighborhood bakery.

negative.description: The user only wants analysis of an existing video and does not ask to create, render, or revise a video.
negative.prompt: Summarize the main points in this uploaded video without editing or creating anything.

publication.release_notes: Fixed video widget content security policy for ChatGPT. Video resources are limited to Google Cloud Storage, and navigation is limited to Motion and its download bridge.
